About Cazcanes Tequila
Cazcanes Tequila is an award-winning ultra-premium tequila brand built on authenticity, craftsmanship, and an uncompromising commitment to quality. Produced using traditional methods, certified organic agave, and natural spring water, Cazcanes has earned a reputation as one of the fastest-growing luxury tequila brands in the United States.
As we continue to expand nationally and internationally, we're looking for a collaborative, creative, and execution-focused Brand Manager to help bring our brand to life across every consumer and trade touchpoint.

Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, the Brand Manager is responsible for executing the Cazcanes brand strategy across consumer, trade, and experiential marketing channels. This role serves as a key member of the marketing leadership team, partnering closely with Sales, Brand Advocacy, Operations, Creative partners, and distributors to deliver marketing initiatives that build brand awareness, deepen consumer engagement, and support commercial growth.
The Brand Manager will translate strategic priorities into exceptional execution by managing integrated marketing campaigns, trade marketing programs, experiential activations, packaging initiatives, CRM programs, and sales enablement tools. This role requires a strong blend of creativity, organization, collaboration, and commercial thinking, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment.

Brand Marketing
Execute integrated marketing campaigns across consumer, trade, experiential, digital, and partnership channels.
Partner with the Chief Marketing Officer to execute annual brand marketing plans that support company growth objectives.
Manage the annual marketing calendar, ensuring campaigns, product launches, partnerships, and activations are delivered on schedule.
Ensure brand consistency across all marketing materials and consumer touchpoints.
Monitor consumer trends, competitive activity, and market insights to identify opportunities that strengthen the brand.
Trade Marketing & Sales Enablement
Develop marketing programs and sales tools that support distributors and the commercial team.

What Will Make You Successful
The ideal candidate is a collaborative marketer who enjoys turning strategy into execution. They are highly organized, commercially minded, and passionate about building premium brands through exceptional storytelling and consumer experiences. They thrive in entrepreneurial environments, build strong cross-functional relationships, and take pride in delivering thoughtful, high-quality work that drives measurable business results.
Salary Range: $100k to 125k plus discretionary bonus, benefits, matching 401k.

Datadog is seeking a (Senior) Field Marketing Manager to develop and execute regional field marketing programs that drive pipeline, build brand awareness, and deliver exceptional customer experiences across the region.

In the initial 6 months, your focus will be on planning and executing a curated slate of first and third-party events and sponsorships across the region.
At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

Develop and execute regional field marketing programs - including campaigns, account-based marketing, and events - that drive pipeline and strengthen Datadog's brand in market

MongoDB is hiring a Staff Product Marketing Manager to build and own our go-to-market narrative for the Public Sector vertical, with an initial focus on Federal Government and the broader public sector market. This is a foundational hire for MongoDB’s Industry Verticals product marketing function: you will define how MongoDB’s unified data platform, spanning cloud, on-premises, and hybrid database deployments with integrated, production-ready AI capabilities, shows up for government buyers.
You’ll turn a major compliance milestone into a durable competitive differentiator: developing the positioning, messaging, and sales-ready content that helps government agencies, systems integrators, and cloud/public-sector resellers understand why MongoDB is the right data platform for mission-critical, regulated workloads.

You do not need prior government or public-sector work experience to succeed in this role — you need to be an excellent product marketer who can get fluent in a new domain quickly and partner closely with the compliance, product, and sales experts who already are.
Scope and phasing
This role is scoped in two phases. Phase 1 is the immediate mandate; Phase 2 is the natural expansion once the federal narrative is established.
Phase 1 — Federal (primary focus at launch). Own the go-to-market narrative for U.S. federal civilian and defense-adjacent buyers. Federal is the harder, higher-compliance-bar, higher-stakes segment — it is also where MongoDB gives the most immediate right to win, so it’s the priority for the first 6–12 months.
Phase 2 — State & Local, Education, and broader Public Sector expansion. Extend the positioning, content, and enablement playbook built in Phase 1 to State & Local Government and Higher Education (“SLED”), adapting messaging and compliance framing to that segment’s different procurement rhythm and compliance bar (see below).

Own positioning and messaging for MongoDB’s Public Sector go-to-market, leading the federal launch, then extending the narrative into State & Local and Higher Education as Phase 2
Translate MongoDB’s data platform capabilities — document database, search, vector search, stream processing, and integrated AI — into mission-relevant outcomes and value propositions for government buyers and the systems integrators who serve them
Partner with Compliance, Security, Industry Solutions and Product teams to accurately represent related certification requirements in external-facing content, staying current as MongoDB pursues additional authorizations (e.g., DoD Impact Levels, StateRAMP)
Build the public sector sales enablement toolkit: battlecards, pitch decks, discovery guides, ROI/value models, and competitive intelligence — tailored first to federal buying processes and procurement vehicles, then adapted for SLED in Phase 2
Develop content — solution briefs, customer decks, whitepapers, case studies, and web content — that makes the case for MongoDB in regulated, mission-critical environments, working within the constraints of public sector reference and PR approval processe
Partner with Field Marketing, Demand Generation, and Partner Marketing to plan and launch public-sector campaigns, events, and co-sell motions with cloud hyperscalers, resellers, and systems integrators
Run competitive and win/loss analysis specific to the public sector segment, feeding insights back into positioning, sales plays, and product roadmap conversations
Serve as the go-to product marketing voice for public sector launches, readiness reviews, and executive/customer-facing engagements.

5–8+ years of product marketing (or closely related GTM/solutions marketing) experience in B2B enterprise software or SaaS, with a track record of owning positioning, messaging, and launches end-to-end
Proven ability to translate complex technical products into clear, differentiated value propositions for both technical and executive audiences — direct experience with data infrastructure, databases, or cloud platforms is a strong plus, not a requirement
Comfort learning and communicating regulatory/compliance concepts well enough to brief sales and build customer-facing content — prior compliance or public-sector experience is a plus, not required
Experience building and running sales enablement programs (battlecards, playbooks, ROI tools) and partnering closely with sales and field marketing teams
Strong cross-functional operator: comfortable driving alignment across product, compliance, sales, partner, and communications teams without direct authority.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to flex between mission-oriented narrative and technical depth
Self-starter who can operate with a fair amount of ambiguity and build structure in a newer, less standardized go-to-market motion
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience; MBA or technical/quantitative background a plus
No security clearance or prior government employment required. U.S. work authorization required; ability to work from a MongoDB office or remotely within the U.S.

Direct experience with FedRAMP, DoD Impact Levels (IL4/5/6), CMMC, or ITAR — either holding the knowledge yourself or having partnered closely with a compliance/SME team to market around it
Familiarity with federal contract vehicles and procurement channels, such as GSA Schedules, NASA SEWP, CIO-SP3, or other GWACs
Experience working with, or marketing through, federal systems integrators and resellers (e.g., Booz Allen Hamilton, Leidos, SAIC) or federal-focused aggregators/resellers (e.g., Carahsoft-style channel partners)
Understanding of federal budget and fiscal-year buying cycles and how they shape campaign and launch timing

Familiarity with StateRAMP as the state-level analog to FedRAMP, and how its bar differs from federal compliance requirements
Understanding of state and local procurement processes (state contract schedules, competitive bid cycles) and higher-education consortium purchasing agreements
Experience adapting a national or federal narrative into a faster-moving, more numerous, typically smaller-deal-size SLED sales motion

Prior experience marketing to any public sector buyer (federal, state & local, or higher education)
Experience marketing database, data platform, analytics, or AI infrastructure products.
About MongoDB
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software.

MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI.

Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

JobRad bike leasing.

Companyevents.
30 days of vacation.

Ich bin Ferdinand, habe in den letzten 10 Jahren 4 Unternehmen erfolgreich gegründet und dabei jedes Mal den Bereich Marketing & Growth verantwortet. Dabei habe ich viel richtig gemacht, einiges falsch, und vor allem eine Menge darüber gelernt, wie aus einem kleinen Startup ein gestandenes Unternehmen wird.
mieteinander ist meine neueste Gründung aus 2024. Den härtesten Weg - die ersten 2 Jahre seit dem Start bei Null- bin ich schon gegangen und weiß inzwischen, welche Kanäle bei uns funktionieren: Messen, Plattformintegrationen, Social Media, Webinare. Die nächste Phase ist jetzt die Skalierung dieser Kanäle. Dafür suche ich dich.
Wir würden eng zusammenarbeiten, und ich gebe gerne weiter, was ich in 10 Jahren gelernt habe. Was du hier vor allem bekommst, ist die Chance, etwas Eigenes entstehen zu sehen. Kampagnen, die du gebaut hast, Zahlen, die sich wegen dir bewegen und vor allem viele zwischenmenschliche Begegnungen- denn die Immobilienbranche ist ein People-Business.
Wer aus dem Marketing kommt, weiß, wie selten es ist, die eigenen Arbeitsergebnisse so klar zu sehen. Du bist kein kleines Rädchen in einem riesigen Uhrwerk, sondern sitzt selbst am Steuerhebel.
Was du mitbringen solltest: Lust, Dinge selbst anzupacken, ohne dass dir jemand jeden Schritt vorgibt. Wenn du das eher anstrengend findest, passen wir vermutlich nicht zusammen. Wenn es dich reizt, lies weiter.
Wir sind mieteinander – bundesweit spezialisiert auf die professionelle Optimierung von Mietverhältnissen in schlecht-vermieteten Wohnobjekten. Für Eigentümer holen wir aus bestehenden Beständen heraus, was möglich ist, ohne die Mieterseite zu vergessen. Unser Anspruch ist die faire Win-Win-Lösung: zufriedene Mieter, deutlich gesteigerte Objektwerte (im Schnitt 30–40 %) und ein Vergütungsmodell, das zu 100 % erfolgsbasiert ist.
Immer mehr Eigentümer geben ihre Objekte in unsere Hände, weil Mietverhandlungen Spezialwissen brauchen, das man sich intern nur schwer aufbaut. Wir übernehmen den kompletten Prozess – von der Potenzialanalyse über die Verhandlung bis zur digitalen Dokumentation.
Damit noch mehr Eigentümer von uns erfahren, suchen wir dich für unser Marketing in München.
Aufgaben
Du übernimmst nicht alles auf einmal. Wir starten mit den Kanälen, die schon laufen, und bauen Schritt für Schritt aus. Deine Schwerpunkte:
Events und Messen: Planung und Durchführung von rund drei Messen pro Jahr, von der Aussteller-Recherche über Berater-Briefings bis zur Koordinierung mit mir zusammen vor Ort.
Webinare: Eigene Webinare in festem Rhythmus aufsetzen und durchführen, inklusive Landing Page und Nachfass-Strecke. Dazu Partner-Webinare mit Finanzierungsvermittlern, Steuerberatern und Vermieter-Communities.
Partnernetzwerk und Tippgeber: Unser Netzwerk aus Steuerberatern, Finanzierungsvermittlern, Hausverwaltungen und Maklern ausbauen. Erstansprache, Onboarding und regelmäßiger Kontakt.
E-Mail-Marketing und Automation: Unseren Erfolgsfall-Newsletter in Newsletter-Tool betreuen und ausbauen, Segmentierung nach Lead-Status, automatisierte Nurture-Strecken (z. B. für Webinar-No-Shows).
Content und Sichtbarkeit: Referenzobjekte und Testimonials auf Website, Newsletter und Instagram ausspielen, unsere Instagram-Agentur steuern, Podcast-Gastauftritte und Fachartikel organisieren.
Reporting und Steuerung: Pipeline-Dashboard pflegen und die Kanäle monatlich über KPIs nachjustieren (Cost-per-Infogespräch, Lead-zu-Termin-Quote je Kanal).
Mittelfristig kommt ein größeres Projekt dazu: eine neue Tochtermarke von mieteinander aufbauen und launchen. Das ist Perspektive, kein Tag-eins-Auftrag.
Qualifikation
Berufserfahrung im Marketing, idealerweise B2B und gern in der Immobilien- oder Finanzbranche. Quereinstieg ist möglich, wenn der Rest passt.
Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenständig und behältst mehrere Kanäle im Blick, ohne den Überblick zu verlieren. Du steuerst über KPIs, liest ein Dashboard und leitest daraus Entscheidungen ab, statt nach Bauchgefühl zu handeln.
Du arbeitest gern mit Menschen, ob am Messestand oder am Telefon mit potenziellen Multiplikatoren. Ein freundliches, verbindliches Auftreten gegenüber Partnern und Beratern gehört für dich dazu.
Erfahrung mit E-Mail-Marketing und gängigen Tools (MailerLite oder vergleichbar, CRM/HubSpot, Landing Pages, Social Media) ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

Du baust das operative Marketing mit auf und siehst direkt, was deine Arbeit bewirkt. Kurze Wege, direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung, schnelle Entscheidungen.
Gehalt : 50.000 bis 70.000 € je nach Erfahrung und ein leistungsbezogener Anteil, der mit unserem Wachstum mitzieht. Wir planen in Stufen und passen an, wenn die Zahlen stimmen.
Arbeitsweise : Flexible Arbeitszeiten, überwiegend Remote, da unser Team über Deutschland verteilt ist. Rund einen Tag pro Woche arbeitest du gemeinsame mit mir, einem der Gründer und CMO, in München, dazu mehrmals im Jahr Reisetätigkeit zu Messen und Beratertagen. Ein guter Mix aus Homeoffice, vor Ort und gemeinsamen Terminen.
Klingt nach dir? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung – ein kurzes Anschreiben und dein Lebenslauf reichen uns. Wenn du Beispiele aus deinem bisherigen Marketing zeigen kannst, umso besser. Bei Fragen vorab kannst du dich jederzeit bei uns melden. Wir melden uns zeitnah zurück.

Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for Discord's developer platform through market research, customer segmentation, competitive analysis, and targeted programs that drive developer awareness, adoption, and long-term platform growth.
Lead activation initiatives across Discord's platform portfolio by crafting differentiated messaging, value propositions, positioning, and go-to-market motions that resonate with game developers and publishers.
Build and scale impactful Business Development and Developer Operations enablement programs—including training, playbooks, product collateral, competitive positioning, implementation guidance, objection handling, and customer-facing tools—to empower internal teams to successfully bring Discord's platform to market.
Define and track platform adoption goals, activation KPIs, and business metrics, continuously refining go-to-market strategies to improve developer adoption and create scalable, repeatable growth.
Act as the voice of developers and strategic partners, translating customer insights into actionable recommendations that influence product strategy, roadmap prioritization, positioning, and future platform investments.
Partner with Business Marketing, Developer Relations, and Communications to establish Discord's thought leadership within the gaming developer ecosystem through industry events, customer stories, technical content, and strategic partnerships.
Lead cross-functional go-to-market planning and execution across Product Management, Engineering, Business Development, Developer Operations, Developer Relations, Marketing, Design, and Legal to ensure successful product launches and organizational readiness.

7+ years of Product Marketing experience in B2B technology, gaming, developer platforms, SaaS, APIs, SDKs, or platform businesses.
Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies for technical products and driving adoption through Business Development, Partnerships, or other customer-facing teams.
Experience building scalable enablement programs, including messaging, positioning, launch materials, training, playbooks, and customer collateral.
Strong understanding of developer ecosystems, technical audiences, and how to translate complex platform capabilities into compelling customer value propositions.
Excellent strategic thinking, communication, and storytelling skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and executive stakeholders.
Experience working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and excitement for building new products, business models, and go-to-market motions from the ground up.
Passion for gaming, developers, and helping partners build successful communities on Discord.

Wir möchten sicherstellen, dass Du perfekt zu uns passt und wir zu Dir! Deshalb haben wir einen transparenten und fairen Bewerbungsprozess, der uns die Möglichkeit gibt, Dich besser kennenzulernen und Dir gleichzeitig einen guten Einblick in unsere Arbeitsweise zu geben. Hier sind die einzelnen Schritte:
Schick uns Deine Bewerbung inklusive Lebenslauf, kleinem Motivationsschreiben und Arbeitsproben (falls vorhanden).
Wir prüfen Deine Bewerbung und bewerten, ob Deine Erfahrungen und Fähigkeiten zu unseren Anforderungen passen. Wir melden uns in der Regel innerhalb von maximal 3 Werktagen bei Dir.
Wenn uns Deine Bewerbung überzeugt, laden wir Dich zu einem ca. 30-minütigen Video-Call ein. Ziel ist es, Dich persönlich kennenzulernen, mehr über Deine Motivation zu erfahren und Dir gleichzeitig mehr über uns, unser Team und unsere Arbeitsweise zu erzählen.

In einem zweiten Gespräch besprechen wir die Ergebnisse der Testaufgabe, klären offene Fragen und vertiefen bestimmte Themen – seien es Fragen zu Deiner Arbeitsweise, Deine Wünsche an uns oder unsere Erwartungen an Dich.
Wenn beide Seiten ein gutes Gefühl haben, senden wir Dir ein verbindliches Angebot zu. Sobald Du zustimmst, starten wir gemeinsam durch!
Hast Du noch Fragen? Wir stehen Dir gerne zur Verfügung. Schreib uns einfach an.
Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen und gemeinsam mit Dir die Zukunft des E-Mail- und WhatsApp-Marketings zu gestalten!

We are open source by design. Our products are developed transparently and in collaboration with a global community of contributors, and that same spirit shapes how we work: collaboratively, inclusively, and with a shared commitment to putting users first.
Our small but growing distributed team includes 65+ people across seven countries. As Thunderbird evolves beyond a single desktop application, we are expanding across desktop, mobile, and paid services to build independent, privacy-respecting alternatives to big tech ecosystems.
Our revenue model combines user donations, which help keep Thunderbird’s apps freely available, with paid services that cover the costs of hosted offerings while supporting long-term sustainability and continued innovation.

About the opportunity
Within Booking Holdings, an enhanced and more connected B2B business is being built within Booking Holdings consolidating the businesses of Booking.com, Priceline and Agoda into a single global division (“New B2B Business”)

Your center of gravity is deep 1:1 / 1:few ABM on your strategic accounts - that is the majority of your time and where the value is. Alongside it you carry a capped, automation-led 1:many (Lead Gen) responsibility across the tail of your archetype: templated, segment-level campaigns that open accounts and book first meetings for BD. The deep work comes first; the 1:many tier is deliberately bounded so it cannot crowd out the committee-level plays. This is not a high-volume MQL-factory role.

Research & target your accounts and form a point of view on which product leads and how the relationship expands.
Run a capped 1:many motion over your tail. Templated, segment-level Lead Gen campaigns (built with the shared Marketing Ops Specialist) to open accounts and book BD meetings - and spot when a warming account should graduate into your 1:few tier. Kept deliberately bounded.
Map the buying committee, design the account plays, and create & adapt bespoke assets for your strategic accounts.
Partner with BD/Sales; run and optimize campaigns in the marketing automation platform; own your measurement layer.
What you will need (required)
4+ years in B2B marketing, with 2+ years in ABM, strategic-account, or field marketing.
Account-research and buying-committee-mapping skill - you can build an account dossier and a stakeholder map and turn them into a plan.
Multi-channel campaign orchestration - multi-touch, multi-stakeholder campaigns (email, LinkedIn, events, direct).
Ability to sell a portfolio, not a single product - comfortable matching the right product to a buyer and articulating an expansion path.
Strong BD/Sales partnership instincts; comfortable working without direct authority.
CRM + MAP fluency - a major CRM (e.g., Salesforce) and a marketing automation platform (Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement, HubSpot, or Marketo).
Data-literate - comfortable defining KPIs and reading dashboards. Strong writing and executive communication. Long-cycle patience and ownership.

Travel, travel-tech, fintech/payments, loyalty, marketplaces, or B2B2C / partnership-led experience.
Exposure to intent-data / ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase, ZoomInfo, Bombora). Event-based engagement (exec dinners, roundtables). ABM certification (ITSMA or equivalent).
Self-serve / PLG onboarding funnels, affiliate/partner-network programs (CJ), or SDR/BDR collaboration. SQL/BI comfort is a plus but not required.
How we will measure success
Primary (70%): buying-committee engagement depth, pipeline influenced, multi-product expansion, deal velocity, and BD-reported influence on strategic accounts. Secondary (30%): qualified leads/meetings generated from the capped 1:many tier and graduation of warming tail accounts into 1:few.

yfood wächst international: Obwohl Deutschland unsers „Home Base“ ist, haben wir mit unseren internationalen Märkten ein dynamisches und buntes Umfeld geschaffen, in dem viele spannende Themen auf Dich warten.

Come as you are. Ob im Anzug oder Einhorn-Onesie. Einen Dresscode kennen wir nicht.

About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

Growth Marketing is a team of performance-driven marketers and channel specialists. We partner closely with growth product, regional and demand marketing, and sales to drive revenue through self-serve and sales motions. We work globally, on the full customer lifecycle, and with all company segments - from startups to the largest enterprises. This role is focused on driving growth for Stripe Capital.
Stripe Capital provides access to fast, flexible financing to businesses, with the mission of helping them accelerate their growth. Businesses use the funds for marketing, hiring, geographic expansion, working capital, new equipment purchases, and much more.

Capital has scaled meaningfully over the last few years, both in terms of user impact (over 81,000 businesses received financing through Stripe Capital in 2025 alone) as well as financial impact as a business line within Stripe.

Over 95% of our users say they love using Capital, making us one of the most popular products at Stripe—and we're just getting started.

You will help create uncommonly great email marketing campaigns and multi-channel experiences for Capital through a relentless focus on user experience and channel optimization.

Hey!
Wir sind vly – ein innovatives FoodTech-Startup aus Berlin, das die Lebensmittelindustrie revolutioniert. Unser Ziel: Gesunde, pflanzliche Milchalternativen, die nicht nur dir guttun sondern auch unserem Planeten.

Nach jahrelanger Forschung haben wir Produkte entwickelt, die deutlich weniger Zucker und mehr Protein enthalten, mit Preisen ausgezeichnet wurden und deutschlandweit erhältlich sind – wie unsere Milchalternativen aus Erbsenprotein und den allerersten Joghurt aus Ackerbohnenprotein. Aber das soll erst der Anfang sein!

Neben der ständigen Verbesserung unserer Produkte ist natürlich unsere Sichtbarkeit im Handel mit der wichtigsten Treiber für die Zukunft von vly. Hier beginnt dein nächster Schritt bei vly...
Deine Mission: Als Trade Marketing Manager:in bist du die Brücke zwischen unserer Marke und dem Handel . Du sorgst dafür, dass vly maximale Aufmerksamkeit im Regal bekommt – durch überzeugende Argumente, aufmerksamkeitsstarke Materialien und aktivierende Maßnahmen, die unsere Produkte noch schneller aus dem Regal heraus verkaufen.

Du berichtest an unsere Head of Marketing, arbeitest aber auch sehr eng mit Sales, Brand und Design zusammen und bist dabei eine der Schlüsselpersonen, die das große Bild von der Brand bis zur Regalplatzierung versteht.

Du trägst zur Entwicklung unserer Trademarketing-Strategie für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz bei und bist für deren Umsetzung verantwortlich.
Du unterstützt unser KAM- und Field-Force-Team beim Entwickeln von überzeugenden Sell-in-Unterlagen und Category-Management-Argumenten für einschlägige LEH-Kunden.
Du planst und koordinierst POS-Maßnahmen: Displayaktionen, Zweitplatzierungen und In-Store-Aktivierungen (z.B. Gewinnspiele).
Du analysierst Marktdaten (Nielsen, GfK, interne Sell-out-Daten) und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.
Du entwickelst starke Trade Marketing Materialien (z.B. Sales Folder, Präsentationen, Wobbler) in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Brand, Design und Sales.
Du organisierst und standardisierst unseren Auftritt bei Trade Messen und Verkostungen in Supermärkten.
Du beobachtest den Wettbewerb sowie die Regalentwicklung und bringst proaktiv Impulse, die unsere Sichtbarkeit und den Impact am POS erhöhen.
Du bist das Verbindungsstück zwischen Marketing, KAM und Field Force mit dem Ziel, effektive Maßnahmen auf Kundenbedürfnisse zuzuschneiden.

Purpose: Es ist absolut essenziell, dass sich das Lebensmittelsystem zum Besseren verändert. Deine Rolle trägt direkt dazu bei, es gesünder und nachhaltiger zu machen.
Impact vom ersten Tag: Du baust Trade Marketing bei vly auf – keine fertige Struktur, die du übernimmst, sondern echte Ownership.
Echtes Startup Teamgefühl: Ein kreatives und motiviertes Team, das zusammenhält – inklusive regelmäßiger vly-Day- und Offsite-Events.
Teamlunch : Unser Highlight - jeden Tag frisch gekochtes Lunch von unserer eigenen vly-Köchin!
Mobilität und Company Fitness: Zuschuss sowohl zum BVG / Deutschland-Ticket sowie zu deiner USC Mitgliedschaft.
Moderne Ausstattung & Coaching: Wir statten dich mit Mac/Windows-Equipment aus und bieten individuelle Coaching-Möglichkeiten.
FoodTech-Community: Sei Teil einer wachsenden Bewegung, mit spannenden Events und Networking-Möglichkeiten.
vly-Flatrate: Genieße so viel vly, wie du willst!
Stellenanforderungen

Hands-on Erfahrung: Du hast 4+ Jahre Berufserfahrung im Trade Marketing oder Category Management in einer FMCG-Brand oder im LEH-Umfeld.
Expertise: Du hast bereits Trade Marketing Konzepte eigenverantwortlich entwickelt und umgesetzt. Displayaktionen, Sonderplatzierungen und kreative Materialien sind für dich kein Neuland.
Netzwerk: Du hast ein Netzwerk von einschlägigen Herstellern von Trade Materialien und kennst die Produktionsprozesse vom Design-Briefing bis zum Versand.
Daten sind deine Grundlage: Du kannst Nielsen-Daten und interne Daten lesen, interpretieren und in überzeugende Storys für den Handel übersetzen.
Mindset: Du denkst unternehmerisch und packst an – du wartest nicht, bis jemand eine Vorlage für dich erstellt.
Struktur: Du bist strukturiert, verlässlich und behältst auch mit mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick.
Stakeholder: Du arbeitest gerne cross-funktional und kannst zwischen Sales, Marketing und externen Partnern vermitteln.
Verfügbarkeit: Du wohnst in Berlin und kannst regelmäßig (mind. 50% der wöchentlichen Zeit) im Büro sein.
Sprache: Du sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprache-Level und sehr gutes Englisch.

Company Description
Workleap is a Montreal-based tech company, founded in 2006. We're builders at heart, we make simple products that actually matter to the people who use them.

We have two product lines: The Workleap Agent , our agentic HR platform that helps managers become better leaders, and ShareGate , the world's leading solution for Microsoft 365 migration and governance. More than 15,000 companies worldwide trust us to do exactly that. We're intentional about who joins us.

If you're the kind of person who gets excited by a hard problem and wants to help shape what comes next, there's a place for you here.

We're looking for a customer marketer who sees our existing customer base as our biggest growth opportunity and who wants to own the work of turning that into expansion, upsell, and retention. This role calls for a data-driven person who can rely on product and market signals to proactively drive our customer program.
You'll take the customers we already have, figure out how to get them more value from Workleap, and build and run the programs that deliver it. You'll own the channels, the messaging, and the results.
This is a hands-on role. You'll run initiatives from start to finish: a webinar, an ABM play, a campaign, an exclusive dinner, name it. This means you need to be just as happy, for instance, to gather signals with your team, draft emails, send your work via HubSpot, and review performance to optimize your next round. This is an A to Z role.

4+ years in customer marketing, product marketing, or a hybrid customer/PMM role in SaaS or tech;
Proven ability to translate positioning into messaging and marketing campaigns, tailored to specific audiences;
Track record of running marketing programs from conception to execution, shaping the idea, briefing creative, and shipping the work yourself when needed;
Comfort with data to segment audiences, spot where customers stall, and measure what your programs return;
Hands-on with HubSpot or a comparable CRM and marketing automation platform for segmentation, workflows, and performance tracking;
Strong cross-functional program ownership, able to keep several initiatives moving at once;
Fluent with AI as a practitioner, using it to do more and better work while keeping the output specific and sharp, never generic;
Leading and owning customer marketing, setting direction for your own programs.
Most of this sounds like you? Apply.
What the job comes with
Base salary: 85K to 105K. This range reflects our Canada-wide compensation scale. Final offers may be adjusted based on the candidate's region to align with local market conditions.
Annual bonus program.
LTIP program, share in Workleap's long-term growth.
RRSP + Family health insurance + telemedicine + annual wellness budget.
Flexible vacation policy.
Remote work, with access to our Montreal office.
In-person gathering twice a year.
Claude access, for everyone.
What drives us
At Workleap, we build software that sits at the center of how people experience work, every day, at every level.
We move fast. Priorities shift, decisions get made with the information we have, and we iterate. If you thrive on intensity and ambiguity doesn't slow you down, you'll feel right at home.
We're builders. We do what it takes to move forward. AI is part of our toolkit. We use it to go faster and decide smarter, not to replace judgment.
If you want real impact and a place where your decisions matter, this is it.
How we hire
Transparency is how we hire — for you and for us.
Your journey starts with a recruiter conversation, followed by a virtual interview with the hiring manager and one additional interviewer. Next, you'll complete a take-home case study and meet potential teammates to discuss and collaborate on your work. If it's a match on both sides, we move to an offer. Some positions follow a slightly different path — your recruiter will walk you through it on the call if that's the case.
In the spirit of transparency: we use AI to support parts of the process, but every hiring decision remains firmly human.
We're committed to making this an inclusive and thoughtful experience for every candidate. We're looking forward to showing you that.

We're looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to scale Decagon's paid social programs internationally, with an initial focus on EMEA. This role owns paid social spend end-to-end—LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, emerging platforms—and is responsible for standing up and scaling an EMEA motion. You'll partner closely with EMEA sales leadership to make sure spend allocation tracks where the deals actually are, not just where measurement is easiest.
This is a channel-owner role for someone who's spiked in paid social specifically and has managed large budgets where efficiency and allocation decisions really matter. While paid social is the core of the role, you'll also flex into adjacent demand gen work—ABM, landing pages, email—as EMEA-specific needs come up.
In this role, you will
Own paid social end-to-end: Run LinkedIn, Meta, X, and emerging platforms from creative brief through launch, optimization, and reporting. You're accountable for efficiency and output across the full paid social budget, not just execution.
Scale spend into EMEA: Stand up and grow a paid social motion in EMEA from its current early stage. Adapt targeting, creative, and budget pacing to local buying behavior, currencies, and compliance requirements (GDPR and beyond).
Align spend to sales opportunity: Partner with EMEA sales leadership to make sure budget allocation tracks where the actual pipeline opportunity is by market and segment, not just where measurement is easiest.
Build the attribution story: Own how paid social spend connects to pipeline and revenue by market and channel. Bring your own point of view on what's working, backed by data, not just activity metrics like CTR and CPL.
Test and systematize: Run structured experiments across creative, audiences, and channels, and turn what works into repeatable playbooks the rest of the team can use.
Flex into adjacent demand gen: Support EMEA-specific ABM, landing pages, and email work as needs come up, in partnership with the broader demand gen team.
Your background looks something like this
5+ years in performance marketing with a clear specialization in paid social (LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, TikTok, or similar) rather than search.
Managed paid social budgets at meaningful scale (six-figure+ monthly spend) and can speak to how you allocated across campaigns, audiences, and markets.
Have run or scaled paid social programs in EMEA specifically—different currencies, buying behaviors, compliance considerations (GDPR, etc.), and local nuances in creative and targeting.
Analytical and comfortable owning your own attribution story: connecting spend by market/channel to pipeline and revenue, not just CTR and CPL.
Used to working cross-functionally with regional sales teams to align spend with where the pipeline opportunity actually is.
Can flex beyond paid social into adjacent demand gen work (ABM, landing pages, email) when EMEA-specific needs call for it.
Thrive in a fast-paced startup environment, where you're expected to take ownership, move quickly, and learn as you go.
Even better if you have
Have experience with Clay or similar audience-building tools and are comfortable building and iterating on paid audiences
Have stood up a paid social program in a new region from scratch (rather than inheriting one already built).
Speak a European language relevant to key EMEA markets (UK, DACH, France, Benelux, Nordics).
Bring point of view on emerging paid social channels or formats worth testing in EMEA.

At Braze, Product Marketing sits at the center of how we bring our platform to market—shaping the narratives, positioning, and go-to-market motions that connect what we build to the value our customers feel.

As part of our Product Marketing team, you'll own narratives and GTM for the strategic technology partnerships that extend what's possible on our platform.

This is a role for a builder and a storyteller: someone energized by turning complex offerings into clear, compelling go-to-market programs, and who thrives working shoulder-to-shoulder with teams across Product, Sales, Partnership, and Marketing to bring them to life.

You will translate Braze's strategic technology partnerships into differentiated messaging, joint go-to-market programs, and field-ready assets that ladder up to our core platform narrative.
This is an individual contributor role focused on strong PMM craft and cross-functional execution. You'll bring a clear understanding of how go-to-market strategies work with technology platform partners, and you'll work closely with internal cross-functional teams including Product, Partnerships, Sales, and Marketing to take initiatives from messaging through to field readiness.
GTM Strategy & Messaging
Develop GTM strategy based on joint business plans for strategic technology partnerships in collaboration with partner leads
Own the messaging architecture for Braze's strategic technology partnerships (e.g., cloud hyperscalers and data platforms), ensuring each partnership ladders up to our core platform narrative and customer engagement story
Translate platform integrations into clear, differentiated value propositions with defined customer use cases and competitive angles
Work with Core Product Marketing to ensure technology partners are reflected accurately in product launches, campaigns, and core messaging
GTM Execution & Enablement
Drive joint go-to-market and co-marketing programs with technology platform partners, coordinating timelines and deliverables across internal teams
Drive partner launch motions end-to-end: messaging, packaging, enablement materials, and field readiness
Build and deliver core assets and enablement that actually get used in the field
Track performance and adoption, and report results back to cross-functional stakeholders
Cross-Functional Execution
Work closely with Product, GTM Strategy, Sales, Marketing, and Partnership to align on priorities and execute against them
Partner with Sales and the field to support active deals, customer conversations, and positioning
What Success Looks Like

s.h: In your first year, success means
s.t:
A repeatable launch and enablement motion for technology platform partnerships, with integrations reflected consistently across launches, campaigns, and core messaging
Trusted, productive relationships across Product, Sales, Partners, Marketing, and Services—you're the person teams pull in early

A storyteller. You turn complex offerings and integrations into clear, differentiated narratives that resonate with buyers and the field alike
A builder. You're comfortable with ambiguity and energized by creating structure, frameworks, and repeatable motions where none existed
A collaborator. You're a sleeves-rolled-up, low-ego operator who brings cross-functional teams along and gets things shipped without direct authority
GTM-fluent. You understand how go-to-market strategies work with technology platform partners and how to execute them in a fast-moving, matrixed organization

s.h: What You Bring to the Team
s.t:
7–10+ years in product and/or partner marketing at a growing B2B technology company, with strong product marketing (PMM) craft at the core
A clear, practical understanding of how go-to-market strategies work with technology platform partners, including joint GTM programs, co-marketing motions, and integration launches
Strong PMM fundamentals: messaging frameworks, competitive positioning, narrative development, and the ability to translate complex offerings and integrations into clear, buyer-ready stories
Experience marketing technology platform partnerships (e.g., cloud hyperscalers, data platforms, and the broader SaaS/martech ecosystem)
Experience building sales and enablement content—solution briefs, battle cards, decks, playbooks—that gets adopted and used by the field
A proven ability to work closely with cross-functional teams and execute without direct authority, navigating a matrixed organization to get things shipped
Excellent communicator, comfortable presenting to internal stakeholders and partners

Experience in customer engagement, marketing technology, CDP, or adjacent data/SaaS categories

Positioning and messaging

Build and maintain the messaging architecture across personas (CFO, VP Finance, FP&A manager) and segments, and hold the organization to it.
Develop pricing and packaging recommendations in partnership with Product and Sales, grounded in willingness-to-pay research rather than instinct.

Go-to-market and launches

Partner closely with Product on roadmap inputs, bringing market and competitive evidence into prioritization conversations.

Adoption and expansion

Drive in-app product adoption in partnership with Product and Customer Success: onboarding narratives, feature discovery, lifecycle messaging. Increase usage and stickiness, and turn that into retention and expansion.
Instrument it. Know which cohorts are adopting what, and why the others aren't.

Content and demand

Set the editorial bar for everything we publish — research reports, whitepapers, case studies, website copy — and defend the difference between genuinely good content and filler.
Partner with Demand Gen to make sure campaigns are built on messaging that converts, not just channels that spend.

Team

5–12 years in B2B SaaS marketing, with at least 4 in product marketing and meaningful experience marketing to technical or financial buyers.
A track record of owning positioning for a product or product line — not just executing launches someone else scoped.
Exceptional written communication. You'll be judged on your writing, and so will we.

Self-directed and comfortable with ambiguity. This is a role with a lot of surface area and not a lot of existing scaffolding.

Humane Choices Foundation Volunteer Digital Marketing Manager Remote | Part-time | Volunteer | Reports to Director of Marketing About Us The Humane Choices Foundation (humanechoice.org) is a Canadian volunteer-driven nonprofit fighting to reduce animal suffering, advance animal rights, and promote plant-based living.

Our work spans farmed animal advocacy, ocean and marine life protection, and education around the environmental cost of industrial animal agriculture. We show up on campuses, online, and wherever young people are asking hard questions about the world they are inheriting. The people who find us tend to stay, because the work feels real.

The Opportunity We are looking for a Volunteer Digital Marketing Manager who understands that the most powerful thing a mission-driven organization can do online is show up when people are actively searching for answers. This role is built around discoverability.

You will own our search presence, shape how we appear in an era where AI tools are changing how people find information, and build a digital marketing engine that works for us around the clock, not just when we post something new.

If you have ever wanted to put serious digital marketing skills toward a cause that genuinely matters, this is that opportunity. What You Will Do Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
Conduct thorough keyword research to identify the terms and questions our target audiences are actively searching for, across animal rights, plant-based living, environmental advocacy, and related topics.
Develop and execute an on-page SEO strategy across our Wix website, including metadata, headings, internal linking, URL structure, and image optimization.
Build an off-page SEO strategy that grows our domain authority through ethical link building, partnerships, and content syndication.
Conduct regular technical SEO audits to identify and fix issues affecting crawlability, page speed, mobile performance, and indexation.
Track keyword rankings, organic traffic, and search visibility and report on progress clearly and regularly.
Collaborate with our content team to ensure every blog post, resource page, and campaign landing page is structured to rank.
Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
Optimize our content to appear in AI-generated answers, featured snippets, and voice search results, understanding that a growing share of our audience will find us through tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and similar platforms.
Structure content using clear question-and-answer formats, schema markup, and authoritative sourcing so that AI tools are more likely to pull from and cite our work.
Identify the questions people are asking about animal rights, veganism, and plant-based living and ensure we have clear, credible, well-structured answers published and optimized on our site.
Monitor how HCF is referenced or cited in AI-generated responses and work to improve our visibility and accuracy within those results over time.
Stay current on how AEO best practices are evolving as AI search tools develop rapidly.
Content Strategy and Distribution
Work closely with our content team to build a content strategy grounded in search demand rather than assumptions about what our audience wants to read.
Ensure content is structured for both human readers and search engines, balancing readability with technical optimization.
Develop a content distribution strategy that extends the reach of every piece we publish beyond organic search, including email, partnerships, and syndication.
Identify evergreen content opportunities that will continue driving traffic months and years after publication.
Repurpose high-performing content into formats suited to different channels and audiences.
Email Marketing
Manage our email marketing program end to end, from list building and segmentation through to campaign creation and performance analysis, within full CASL compliance.
Write and structure emails that drive meaningful action, whether that is reading a new blog post, sharing a resource, signing a petition, or supporting the foundation.
Build automated sequences for new subscribers that introduce HCF, establish trust, and deepen engagement over time.
Track and improve open rates, click-through rates, and list health consistently.
Paid Digital and Performance Marketing
Plan and manage paid search campaigns through Google Ads, including nonprofit grant applications to access Google Ad Grants for eligible organizations.
Develop and test paid campaigns on Meta or other platforms when budget allows, with a clear focus on measurable outcomes.
Ensure all paid activity is tied to clear conversion goals and tracked properly.
Report on paid performance in plain language with honest assessment of return on investment.
Analytics and Reporting
Own our analytics infrastructure, ensuring Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and any other tracking tools are properly set up and producing reliable data.
Report weekly on core metrics including organic traffic, keyword rankings, email performance, and campaign results.
Translate data into clear recommendations that the broader team can understand and act on.
Use performance insights to continuously refine our digital marketing approach across every channel.

s.h: What We Are Looking For Required
s.t:
Demonstrated experience in digital marketing with a specific focus on SEO, including both on-page and technical optimization.
Working knowledge of AEO principles and how AI-driven search is changing content discoverability.
Familiarity with tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar.
Strong analytical thinking with the ability to turn data into clear, actionable decisions.
Good writing skills with an understanding of how to write content that serves both readers and search engines.
Self-directed and organized, comfortable managing multiple priorities in a remote volunteer environment.
Genuine alignment with the mission and values of the Humane Choices Foundation.

Experience running Google Ad Grants for a nonprofit organization.
Familiarity with schema markup and structured data implementation.
Background in content marketing, particularly for advocacy, health, or sustainability topics.
Knowledge of CASL and Canadian email marketing compliance.
Experience with Wix SEO tools or similar website platforms.
Understanding of how large language models and AI search tools index and surface content.
Why Join Us SEO and AEO work compounds over time. The rankings you build, the answers you optimize for, the authority you establish, those keep working long after the effort that created them. At HCF, that compounding effect goes toward protecting animals and shifting how people think about the choices they make every day. That is a worthwhile place to put serious skills.
Strategic ownership of our entire digital marketing and search presence.
The opportunity to build an SEO and AEO foundation from scratch, the right way.
A flexible, fully remote volunteer arrangement built around your life.
Close collaboration with our content, video, and leadership teams.

Over the last two years, consumer growth at Octopus Electric Vehicles has accelerated fast. We’ve grown our B2C activity significantly, and we’re now looking for someone brilliant to take day-to-day ownership of our digital performance engine.
This is a hands-on role for someone who loves being close to the detail: building campaigns, digging into search query reports, spotting optimisation opportunities, improving audiences, testing creative, reporting clearly, and helping us move faster.
You’ll sit in the B2C Growth squad, reporting into the Senior Growth Marketing Manager, and will own paid digital activity across paid search, programmatic and paid social. You’ll work closely with our Content Creator, Design team, Commercial team and wider Marketing team to get campaigns live quickly, optimise performance, and unlock new areas of growth.
Paid media is the heart of this role, but you'll also own key parts of the user journey, including writing, building, and launching campaign landing pages using our web tools to ensure end-to-end performance. Over time, there may also be the opportunity to support organic social planning, scheduling, and reporting alongside our Content Creator.
This would suit someone with strong hands-on performance marketing experience, ideally from an agency or fast-paced digital environment, who is ready to step into an in-house role with more ownership, more visibility, and more chance to shape what happens next.

🚀 Own our paid digital channels: Build, manage and optimise campaigns across paid search, paid social and programmatic display, helping us reach more people ready to make the switch to electric.
🔍 Get properly stuck into the detail: Dive into search query reports, audiences, bids, budgets and campaign performance to spot what’s working, what’s wasting spend, and where the next opportunity is.
🔧 Keep the digital engine humming: Work hands-on across SA360, DV360, Campaign Manager and Meta Ads Manager, making sure campaigns are set up cleanly, tracking works, audiences flow through, and everything goes live without drama.
📈 Spend smartly: Help manage digital spend within agreed monthly targets, reporting regularly on pacing, CPL and performance, with clear recommendations on where to push, pause or test next.
🧪 Test, learn, repeat: Partner with our Content Creator and Design team to test new creative hooks, formats, audiences and messaging across paid search, paid social and programmatic.
📊 Make reporting actually useful: Turn channel data into clear, practical insight, helping the B2C squad understand what’s happening, why, and what we should do next.
🌐 Own landing page launches & web optimisations: Take end-to-end ownership when campaigns require new landing pages and other pieces of content like quizzes, drafting page copy (with support from the team), building them using our CMS/web tools, and setting them live.
🤝 Make things happen: Coordinate briefs, assets, links, tracking and launches across content, design, web and wider marketing teams so campaigns get live quickly and with as little faff as possible. You’ll also be happy jumping into wider growth priorities when the team needs it.
What you'll need
Strong experience of hands-on performance marketing experience, ideally in a fast-paced agency, media, content or high-growth in-house environment. We’re open on exact years of experience - what matters most is your technical ability, curiosity and attitude.
Strong paid search experience, with the confidence to build, manage and optimise campaigns day to day, including search query analysis, bid optimisation, budget pacing and performance reporting.
Experience with Google Marketing Platform, especially SA360 and Campaign Manager. DV360 experience would be a big plus, particularly if you’ve worked on programmatic display campaigns.
Experience managing paid social campaigns, ideally in Meta Ads Manager, with a good understanding of how creative, audiences, placements and formats affect performance.

s.h: As a Senior Marketing Manager, Growth, you'll
s.t:
Own web optimization and A/B testing in partnership with the demand-gen team. Run a structured, high-velocity experimentation program on webflow.com — hypothesis to live test to statistically valid result — using our experimentation and personalization stack (Webflow Optimize and equivalents). Set the test roadmap, defend statistical rigor, and turn win rate and conversion lift into reported KPIs, not anecdotes.
Own the web-side execution of AEO in partnership with the AEO lead. The AEO lead owns methodology, measurement, and category strategy; you own what makes webflow.com win citations and manage site performance improvements, accessibility, site architecture best practices.
You are the AEO lead's trusted site-side partner — the one who turns their strategy into live citation wins on webflow.com.
Run webflow.com as a "living" website, not a project that ships and stops. Own the continuous development of the site — page and component build, design QA, performance, and iteration velocity — so the site is always evolving in-platform. This is the customer-zero narrative made real: Webflow on Webflow, demonstrated through webflow.com, built and optimized on our own product every day.
Turn webflow.com into an account-level pipeline engine. Lead the on-brand experimentation, personalization stack, and conversion architecture that converts ICP-matched traffic into qualified pipeline. Partner closely with Demand Gen to ensure web experiences reflect and reinforce active sales-led pipeline initiatives (ABM target accounts, named-account journeys, and campaign-specific landing experiences).
Build and ship,beyond building briefs. Design, build, and ship landing pages and site experiences end to end in-platform — you're hands-on in the product, closing the loop from hypothesis to live page yourself rather than handing specs to a queue. (Anthropic growth-engineer archetype: high agency, technical hands-on build.)
Own the web measurement layer. Instrument event tracking, funnel analytics, and attribution for site-sourced pipeline so every experiment and every AEO/answer-engine visit is measurable end to end — and so web's contribution to pipeline is provable, not asserted. (Profound archetype: answer-engine visibility instrumented as a measurable funnel.)
Support campaign orchestration across the web as a channel. You don't own or operate the orchestration engine — you represent webflow.com as a coordinated channel within it.

Wire site behavior signals and on-site responses into the cross-channel play, and execute the web slice of an orchestrated account motion so a single account signal (AEO citation, site behavior, paid engagement) triggers a coordinated web response, not a siloed one.

Partner with Marketing Ops, RevOps, and the AI-native team who own the orchestration layer.
Drive opportunities for Sales as the north star, instrumenting the signal-to-pipeline feedback loop that makes intent signals a stronger conversion predictor than firmographic ICP rating.
Partner cross-functionally as a peer to Demand Gen, Partner Marketing, PMM, and the broader Revenue org, protecting scope clarity while making Growth Platforms the substrate the entire Revenue Marketing org runs on.
Own and optimize a high-traffic B2B SaaS marketing website as a product , driving continuous improvements across user experience, performance, conversion, and experimentation rather than managing one-off website projects.
Define and lead a mature experimentation program , establishing testing strategy, experimentation infrastructure, and best practices while delivering measurable improvements in conversion and pipeline through statistically rigorous testing.
Bring deep expertise in technical SEO and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) , implementing structured data, crawlability, site architecture, and content optimizations that increase both organic search visibility and AI-powered answer engine discoverability.
Leverage marketing analytics to drive business outcomes , implementing instrumentation, funnel analytics, attribution, and measurement frameworks that demonstrate marketing's contribution to qualified pipeline and revenue.
Apply AI to production growth workflows , deploying AI agents and automation to improve content, routing, personalization, and optimization while maintaining appropriate human oversight.
BA/BS degree or equivalent experience

s.h: You'll thrive as a Senior Marketing Manager, Growth if you
s.t:
Think in systems, not campaigns. When a channel underperforms, you look at the signal layer, not the campaign copy. When a page converts, you ask what feedback loop just closed.
Ship and iterate. You'd rather run ten disciplined tests than debate one perfect page. You have a bias toward getting a valid experiment live this week, and a hypothesis-first instinct for what to test next.
Are technically fluent enough to be dangerous. You can read a Marketo trigger, sanity-check a schema markup change, QA a page built in Webflow, and interpret a Tableau attribution model without a translator. You partner with GTM Engineering as a peer, not a customer.
Distinguish signal from noise in intent data. You know why a hand-raiser can convert dramatically better than a LinkedIn lead, and you build campaign design around that reality.

In this role, you will be the ultimate event strategist, relationship builder, and local community orchestrator. You will own the local vibe, turning offline gatherings into powerful brand advocacy and measurable pipeline growth. If you possess a proven track record of flawless event production and live and breathe the hospitality scene, we want you on our team.

Experiential Production & Execution: Own the end-to-end ideation, logistics, and execution of local activations. This ranges from intimate morning roundtables and working lunches to exclusive, late-night industry networking events hosted at customer venues.
Activate "Local Legends" (Anchor Program): Partner with our most prominent existing customers to utilize their venues as anchor locations. Curate high-impact events that naturally attract local industry influencers, top chefs, consultants, and premium prospects.
Vendor & Venue Management: Source, negotiate with, and manage local venues and suppliers. Ensure all activations are executed flawlessly, on budget, and up to brand standards while maintaining a strict run-of-sheet.
Ecosystem Networking: Identify and forge strong relationships with key external stakeholders, trade associations, and hospitality trailblazers to deeply embed Lightspeed into the local culinary and nightlife fabric.
Commercial Alignment: Collaborated closely with Field Sales teams to keep regional marketing materials hyper-relevant, arming them with the localized insights and success stories you gather on-site.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Regional Integrated Marketing Managers (for campaign alignment), Product Marketing (for product messaging), and Social/Content teams to ensure local event magic translates into compelling digital content.
How You’ll Track Success
We believe event magic should drive measurable business growth. You will be responsible for linking your offline activations directly to our digital sales funnel:
Pipeline Attribution & ROI: Maintain meticulous tracking to ensure every local event, dinner, or influencer activation directly maps to lead generation, sales pipeline, and closed-won revenue.
Event Performance Metrics: Partner with Integrated Marketing Managers to establish and hit clear targets for event attendance, cost-per-attendee, and post-event guest sentiment.
Data-Driven Reporting: Author concise, monthly performance reports that demonstrate how localized field activities directly accelerate regional sales velocity and brand engagement.
Event Tech Optimization: Utilize CRM tools, event management platforms, and data analytics dashboards to measure campaign influence and uncover insights on which city-specific tactics truly move the needle.
What It Takes to Succeed
Proven Event Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience in event planning, field marketing, or experiential production. You know how to troubleshoot on the fly and deliver a seamless guest experience.
Language Skills: Fluent in German with professional working proficiency in English.
Hospitality DNA: You are completely at home in the hospitality industry. You understand how restaurants, bars, and venues operate, speak their language, and ideally possess an existing network of operators or influencers.
Field-First Mindset: You thrive on being out of the office and "on the floor" at activations. You have high emotional intelligence and excel at managing live, fast-paced environments.
Strategic & Autonomous: You are a self-starter who doesn't need a rigid playbook. You can spot an opportunity to bring a community together, build a business case and budget for it, and execute it flawlessly.
Sales-Minded Hustler: You recognize that events are a vital top-of-funnel driver. You instinctively know how to guide a great event conversation into a meaningful discovery opportunity for our sales team.
Nice-to-Haves
Tech & CRM Literacy: Experience tracking campaign influence within enterprise tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, or Looker.
Attribution Savvy: Direct experience deploying UTM links, trackable QR codes, and digital landing pages to measure physical-to-digital engagement.

Field Marketing Manager (f/m/x)
Most field marketing roles are run as logistics: book the booth, ship the banners, scan the badges, hand a spreadsheet to sales, move on. This one is built differently. You own events as a pipeline channel, from the target you set before booking to the deals that close because you made the follow-up happen. It's a more strategic seat than field marketing usually gets, and it's yours to run.
doinstruct builds software that helps organizations train and enable their frontline teams, the people in factories, logistics, and service environments who are hardest to reach with conventional L&D. Our customers are manufacturers, industrial operators, and traditional enterprises, which means our events aren't generic SaaS conferences. You'll be in the rooms where these buyers actually are, and you'll own what we get out of being there.
This is also a solo seat. The trade-show calendar already exists, so you're not starting from zero, but there's no playbook yet for turning it into pipeline. If you're excited to own programs end to end, experiment with new approaches, and build the field marketing motion from the ground up, this role is for you.
🎯 What you'll own
Set a pipeline target for every event (owned, sponsored, in-person, virtual), and own what it returns.
Run events end to end: choose the right ones, negotiate vendor packages and speaker slots, handle the logistics, and catch what's about to go wrong.
Pull SDRs and managers into working the leads an event generates, and stay on it past the handoff.
Own the pipeline-driving webinar program, separate from our learning webinars, including partner co-runs where they make sense.
Run smaller local activations across DACH: regional meetups, community events, and customer visits that fit a non-digital-native frontline audience.
Manage the people around an event, from vendors to the SDRs and managers you need for follow-up to the CEO when you need a deck approved, including saying no to an internal favorite when you have to.
Grow into leading the field marketing function as doinstruct expands beyond one market.

You've run events or webinars with real ownership of the moving parts, not just assisted on someone else's.
You've been measured on, or worked closely against, the pipeline events generated. You can tell us what a past event returned and why.
You've coordinated vendors, and you've pulled internal people, including senior ones, into making an event work.
You're based in Germany, fluent in German, and fine with regular travel to events around the country. This role can't be done remotely.
Bonus, not a requirement: B2B SaaS experience, and you already use AI tools in how you work.
🤩 What's different here
You own the channel, not a slice of it. That's the upside and the hard part in one sentence. There's no senior field marketer above you setting the plan, which means more ownership than most people at your level get, and also more rope. The follow-up loop with sales is yours to make work, and our customer base means the events are more specific and more interesting than the usual SaaS circuit.
🚀 Why doinstruct
400+ customers, Series A funded, below 2% churn. The product is a genuine must-have, which makes the conversation at an event easier.
The marketing team has just finished forming, so you're joining at a point where what you build sticks.
We're moving AI-first as a company and will actively help you get deeper into AI tooling, because that's the direction we're going.
A real path to lead field marketing as we expand beyond a single market.
📈 What success looks like

Introduction
Du willst nicht einfach Kampagnen abarbeiten sondern Marketing von Grund auf aufbauen? Du denkst in Systemen, hast ein Gespür für Zahlen und weißt gleichzeitig, wie man Botschaften formuliert, die ankommen?
Wir sind Omnora, eine B2B SaaS-Company aus Frankfurt. Wir helfen Unternehmen wie DB, AOK und ADAC dabei, ihr Wissen zu sichern, zu strukturieren und nutzbar zu machen - mit KI.
Als unser Marketing Manager bist du von Tag 1 an die treibende Kraft hinter unserem gesamten Marketing. Du steuerst Kampagnen über alle Kanäle hinweg, baust unsere Performance-Marketing-Infrastruktur auf und entwickelst Schritt für Schritt eine Struktur, aus der langfristig eine echte Marketingabteilung entsteht. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem Management Team zusammen - ohne festgefahrene Prozesse, dafür mit echter Gestaltungsfreiheit.
Kurz gesagt: Du bist unser Founding Marketing Manager. Was du hier aufbaust, gehört dir.
What's in it for me
Founding-Role mit echter Ownership: Du baust nicht in einer Abteilung mit - du baust die Abteilung. Was du hier aufbaust, trägt langfristig deinen Fingerabdruck und bietet dir echte Entwicklungsperspektive in Richtung Marketing Lead.
Blitzschnelles Lernen: Du tauchst in alle Disziplinen ein - von Content über Performance bis Automation - und lernst in Monaten, wofür andere Jahre brauchen.
Gestaltungsfreiraum: Statt festgefahrener Prozesse erwartet dich maximaler Freiraum, Dinge auszuprobieren.
Kurze Wege, großer Einfluss: Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und siehst, wie deine Arbeit das Unternehmen bewegt.
Hybrides Arbeiten: Was zählt, ist dein Beitrag - nicht wo du sitzt. Wir arbeiten hybrid aus Frankfurt mit flexiblen Home-Office-Möglichkeiten.
Der perfekte Einstiegszeitpunkt: Mit marktreifem Produkt und starken Referenzen stehen wir vor dem nächsten Wachstumsschritt - der ideale Moment, um einzusteigen und mitzugestalten.
How you can make an impact
Performance Marketing & Lead Generation: Du planst, steuerst und optimierst Kampagnen auf Google Ads und LinkedIn mit einem klaren Ziel: qualifizierte Leads für unser Sales-Team. CPL, ROAS und Pipeline-Contribution sind deine Währung - nicht nice-to-haves, sondern tägliche Steuerungsgrößen.
Account-Based Marketing: Du entwickelst ABM-Kampagnen, die gezielt Enterprise-Accounts in der DACH-Region ansprechen - mit den richtigen Botschaften, zur richtigen Zeit, auf den richtigen Kanälen.
Omni-Channel Orchestrierung: Du steuerst alle Marketingkanäle zusammen - Paid, Organic, Content, Email - und sorgst dafür, dass sie als System funktionieren statt als Einzelmaßnahmen nebeneinander zu laufen.

Reporting to the SEA Head of Marketing, you'll work closely with cross-functional teams across Taiwan and the wider region to shape strategy, deliver impactful campaigns, and represent the Taiwan market at a regional and global level.
You'll partner with teams across Music, Growth, Communications, Business Development, Partnerships, and other functions to bring Spotify's brand to life in Taiwan and help unlock new opportunities for growth.

Own Spotify Taiwan's consumer marketing strategy, driving free user acquisition, engagement, and Premium consideration
Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social, out-of-home, experiential, and earned media with ideas designed to spark conversation and deliver measurable business impact
Lead go-to-market planning for key product launches, seasonal campaigns, and major cultural moments
Localize global campaigns for Taiwanese audiences, ensuring every activation reflects genuine cultural relevance rather than simple translation
Use audience insights, market intelligence, and campaign performance data to inform decisions and continuously optimize marketing effectiveness
Measure, analyze, and communicate campaign performance to regional leadership through clear recommendations and actionable insights
Lead Spotify's Taiwan brand strategy in alignment with regional and global positioning while ensuring the brand feels authentic and locally meaningful
Partner closely with the Taiwan Music team to develop campaigns supporting priority local and global releases and create scalable marketing frameworks for label partners
Manage the Taiwan marketing budget, prioritizing investments that deliver the greatest impact
Build and maintain strong relationships with creative, media, production, and agency partners to consistently deliver high-quality work
Act as the voice of the Taiwan market, influencing regional and global stakeholders on campaign strategy, creative development, and market priorities

You have 6+ years of experience in consumer or brand marketing, with strong experience leading marketing initiatives in Taiwan
You have deep knowledge of Taiwan's music, entertainment, and cultural landscape, including Mandopop, emerging artists, internet culture, and local media
You have successfully led integrated marketing campaigns from strategy through execution that delivered measurable business results
You have created or led campaigns and social content that generated outsized reach, engagement, or cultural conversation relative to budget
You know how to use data and customer insights to develop business cases, evaluate campaign performance, and optimize future marketing investments
You have experience managing agencies, external partners, and cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced environment
You have exceptional storytelling instincts and understand how to create culturally relevant campaigns that resonate with Taiwanese audiences
You communicate confidently with senior stakeholders and can influence decisions across regional and global teams
You are highly organized, comfortable managing multiple priorities, and thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment
You have experience working within technology, media, entertainment, or other consumer-focused industries
You are fluent in both Mandarin and English, written and spoken

This role is based in Taipei

Who We Are
Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together . We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

We're hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to join our Product and Lifecycle Marketing team. In this role, you'll design and optimize lifecycle programs that engage, retain, and grow members across their entire journey with Chime—from top of funnel through long-term retention—with a clear focus on driving growth, revenue, and member lifetime value (LTV).
This is a role for a holistic, business-minded marketer rather than a single-channel specialist.

You'll think in terms of segments, experiments, and outcomes: building targeted campaigns across the channels we own—push, in-app, and out-of-app (email, SMS)—while connecting those touchpoints with the broader, non-owned channels that shape the member experience.

You'll partner closely with cross-functional teams to turn data into segmentation, automation, and personalization strategies that move the business.
This is a role with department-level impact: you'll own diverse projects, exercise significant independent judgment, and influence how members experience Chime across the full lifecycle.
If you're creative, dedicated, and love working in a fast-paced environment alongside passionate colleagues, we want to meet you.
The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $139,000 and up to $181,000. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.
In this role, you can expect to
Own full-funnel lifecycle strategy—from top of funnel through activation and long-term retention—building targeted campaigns that drive growth, revenue, and member LTV.
Define segments and translate them into targeted, personalized campaigns across owned channels (push, in-app, and out-of-app), connecting them with the broader non-owned channels that shape the end-to-end member experience.
Generate data-driven hypotheses and run experiments to continuously optimize evergreen lifecycle campaigns and transactional communications, working with analytics to measure impact, socialize findings, and develop next steps toward bigger wins.
Develop and steward channel guidelines and governance, preserving the quality and integrity of our communications ecosystem.
Collaborate and build strong relationships with partners across Product, Product Marketing, Engineering, Analytics, Design, User Research, CRM, and more to develop and deliver on shared strategies for large cross-functional initiatives.
To thrive in this role, you have
4–6+ years of experience in lifecycle, growth, or related marketing, developing end-to-end campaigns from conceptualization to measurement.
A growth-oriented, business-first mindset—you think about revenue, LTV, and the full funnel, not just individual channels, and you can connect owned channels (push, in-app, out-of-app) with the broader member experience.
A proven track record of building segments and managing successful campaigns across multiple channels (email, push, SMS, in-app messaging).
Strong experimentation chops—comfortable with A/B testing and using results to inform what to scale next.
Strong analytical skills with experience in data-driven marketing and performance analysis.
The ability to work cross-functionally and collaborate with various stakeholders, exercising significant independent judgment.
Experience with key marketing platforms (Braze, Looker; AI tools a plus).
A strong self-starter mindset—adaptable and able to think critically to develop creative solutions with limited resources.

Own the end-to-end email marketing strategy and execution

Work cross-functionally with product, CRM/lifecycle, design, and community management to align email with pushes, SMS, and other channels
Present weekly performance reviews and improvement plans to leadership

Fluent English

Minimum 3 years of experience working specifically in email marketing for online casino / iGaming / social casino brands
Experience working with an email database with 10M+ contacts , including hygiene, and deliverability management at scale
Demonstrated experience building and managing deep user segmentation (10–15+ live segments simultaneously, e.g., by VIP tier, deposit status, lifecycle stage)
Experience running daily email broadcasts to a fully segmented database (not just occasional campaigns)
Strong understanding of casino/gaming lifecycle marketing: FTD (first-time deposit) conversion, VIP tiering, re-engagement, and expiring/time-sensitive offers
Experience coordinating email with other channels (push, SMS, in-app) as part of a unified promo calendar
Experience setting up A/B tests for subject lines, send times, and offer creatives
