We are looking for a high-performing candidate to join our Marketing team as a Senior Product Marketing Manager. This person must have experience at high-growth technology companies and will be responsible for defining the value proposition of their product line and creating collateral and sales enablement tools.

We are looking for someone who quickly grasps changing customer needs, market trends, and the competitive landscape, and is passionate about communicating product value to the marketplace.
In your role as a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will be an expert in buyers, how they buy, their buying criteria and will transfer that knowledge across multiple internal teams.

Success in the role requires strong communication skills, a strategic mindset, a deep understanding of the product marketing discipline, of Jamf products, the market, competition, Apple products and the ability to inspire and effectively collaborate with marketing, product management, product strategy, engineering, sales and other customer-facing teams.
This role is remote in the UK. We are only able to accept applications for those based in the UK or have sponsorship to live and work in the UK.

s.h: What you can expect to do in this role
s.t:
Messaging – develop insight-driven product positioning and messaging that differentiates Jamf in the market in collaboration with other teams. Consistently refine positioning based on market feedback
Enablement – communicate the Jamf value proposition across multiple products to internal teams and develop tools that support the needs of those teams for customers, including sales pitch decks, sales training, and outreach content.
Product launch – coordinate the market launch of product releases and manage the cross-functional implementation of the plan. Consistently evaluate launch success and adjust approach based on market feedback
Awareness and demand generation – collaborate with marketing to influence, drive and support marketing programs that build awareness and drive demand
Assets – Create product and industry-related marketing assets such as white papers, collateral, videos, case studies, presentations, blog/social topics, and more in collaboration with the marketing team
Intelligence - be the expert on the market, our market segments, the buyers – including personas, how they buy and their buying criteria – and our competition. Be seen as the subject matter expert for this intelligence and share it regularly.
Events – support and present at Jamf events, webinars, industry events and internally to educate, build awareness and position Jamf.
Cross-functional collaboration – build strong relationships with product strategy, product management, marketing, sales/account management team, customer support and other internal teams
Data analysis - Synthesizes data from a variety of sources to produce and communicate a compelling vision for QBRs, board meetings, marketing planning, etc. and participates in executive strategy sessions
Executive projects - Manage strategic, highly visible, cross-functional projects that impact Jamf’s business. Examples include launching a new software tool, win/loss program or a new customer advisory board.
Analyst relations - Build relationships with key market analysts, conduct briefings and secure favorable mentions of Jamf in analyst publications.

5+ years of product marketing experience
3+ years of general marketing experience at a B2B technology company
Experience working with key internal teams and customers to assess and define market needs
Excellent analytical, quantitative and problem-solving skills

Okta is seeking a highly analytical and forward-thinking Global Paid Search Marketing Manager with exceptional Martech integration skills to join our Global Digital Acquisition Team.
In this role, you won't just manage campaigns, you will own our search portfolio's evolution. You will be responsible for moving beyond traditional lead-gen metrics to implement advanced Value-Based Bidding (VBB) models that align search spend directly with downstream pipeline value.

Leveraging cutting-edge AI capabilities and robust statistical testing, you will maintain complete visibility over all in-market campaigns, ensuring every dollar spent is backed by data and optimized for maximum business impact.

Value-Based Strategy & Execution: Develop and execute comprehensive, AI-driven paid search strategies across Google Ads and Bing Ads. Lead the transition to and optimization of Value-Based Bidding (VBB) models to prioritize high-value pipeline and revenue over raw lead volume.
AI Integration & Innovation: Proactively leverage AI and machine learning capabilities within search platforms (e.g., Smart Bidding, Broad Match + Smart Bidding loops, AI-powered ad assets and campaign types) to scale performance, uncover hidden demand, and push our strategy past the industry curve.
Rigorous Experimentation: Design, execute, and analyze structured A/B and multivariate tests (bidding, copy, landing pages). Champion a scientific approach, ensuring all test outcomes are measured for statistical significance before scaling.
Holistic In-Market Reporting: Maintain a unified, real-time view of all in-market campaigns. Deliver clear, executive-ready reporting that tracks performance across the entire funnel from click to closed-won revenue ensuring complete transparency of our search footprint.
Martech & Data Integration: Collaborate closely with Marketing Operations and Digital Analytics teams to ensure seamless integration with CRM platforms (Salesforce) and marketing automation (Marketo). Ensure accurate offline conversion tracking (OCT) to feed VBB algorithms high-quality feedback loops.
Audience & Competitive Intelligence: Conduct advanced keyword research, competitive benchmarking, and first/third-party audience segmentation to identify high-intent targeting opportunities.
Process Automation: Identify opportunities for workflow automation, scripting, and process improvement to increase operational efficiency and scale our search program.
Account Hygiene & Automation: Actively audit account architecture to eliminate query bleeding and campaign cannibalization. Identify opportunities for workflow automation, scripting, and process improvement to scale our search program cleanly.

Education: BA or BS in Marketing, Business, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related analytical field.
Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience managing enterprise-level, full-funnel paid search campaigns, media planning, and advanced measurement.
Analytical Rigor: Exceptional analytical skills with a proven track record of using statistical significance models to validate test results and drive data-backed decisions.
VBB Expertise: Strong experience implementing and optimizing Value-Based Bidding (VBB) and offline conversion feedback loops (connecting CRM data back to ad platforms).
AI Literacy: Practical experience leveraging AI-driven search features, automated bidding algorithms, and predictive analytics tools to scale and optimize campaigns.
Martech Proficiency: Deep expertise in Google Ads, Bing Ads, Salesforce (CRM), Marketo/Eloqua (Marketing Automation), and advanced web analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GTM, or equivalent).
Project Management & Communication: Strong project management skills with the ability to translate complex, multi-layered data points into clear, concise, and actionable insights for cross-functional stakeholders.
B2B Context: Prior experience in B2B SaaS marketing is highly preferred.

Pinterest is looking for an Email & Lifecycle Marketing Specialist to help build and scale email and push programs for our business audiences. In this role you’ll partner across Marketing, Creative, Sales, Product and IT to deliver thoughtful, data-informed campaigns that drive advertiser awareness, engagement and revenue growth.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys combining strategy, execution and analysis while helping shape growing email programs with meaningful business impact.

Develop and execute email and push programs for Pinterest’s business audiences that drive advertiser awareness, engagement, and revenue growth. Own the process, including brief development, collaboration with Creative on copy and design, QA, launch and reporting.
Partner with Email Marketing Manager and Mid-Market Marketing Director to develop email strategies that reflect business priorities, support go-to-market initiatives and create a consistent experience for advertisers.
Run a structured testing and optimization program. Conduct tests across audience signals, funnel stage, messaging, design, cadence and more. Analyze performance data, synthesize findings into actionable recommendations and continuously improve program efficiency and impact over time.
Provide operational support for email marketing tools, including maintenance of Salesforce Account Engagement.
Use AI to improve existing email processes and develop new ones as needed. Help create new templates, codify testing frameworks, improve intake and launch workflows, identify automation opportunities to make email programs more scalable.
Maintain a high bar for quality, compliance and customer experience across all sends, including list health, deliverability best practices, data privacy laws and clear, on-brand messaging.

At least 3 years of experience in email, CRM or lifecycle marketing, ideally in a B2B environment. Experience supporting advertiser, sales-led, or mid-market audiences is a plus.
Proficiency with a marketing automation platform (Salesforce Account Engagement preferred). Should be comfortable building and launching campaigns, running reports in Salesforce, maintaining data hygiene and trouble-shooting.
Strong campaign execution skills, including campaign set up, QA, scheduling, stakeholder coordination and deployment.
Experience with audience segmentation, targeting and personalization based on lifecycle stage, engagement signals or business priorities.
Experimentation and analytics, including A/B testing methodology, performance reporting, insight generation, and translating results into actionable recommendations.
Has previously partnered closely with creative teams on design and copywriting for emails. Strong eye for clear messaging, user experience and brand consistency.
Strong cross-functional communication and collaboration skills. Partners effectively with Marketing, Sales, Product and IT stakeholders.
Operational rigor and attention to detail, including documentation, QA, process discipline and comfort managing multiple campaign workflows in a fast-paced environment.
Demonstrated ability to use AI to accelerate workflows such as intake and launch processes, copy ideation, analysis and reporting, while applying sound judgment, validating outputs and maintaining ownership of final work.
Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience.

**Description du poste**
En tant que Spécialiste en Marketing d'Influence, vous serez au cœur de notre équipe de Marketing Digital, façonnant des partenariats impactants avec des créateurs et donnant vie à des projets innovants.

Travaillant en étroite collaboration avec nos filiales, vous développerez et exécuterez des stratégies d'influence qui connectent avec les audiences, élèvent la visibilité de la marque et stimulent l'engagement.

Alliant votre passion pour le sport, la culture des créateurs et la gestion de projets, vous transformerez les collaborations en expériences de marque significatives.
**Responsabilités clés**
**Stratégie Globale d'Influence et de Créateurs**
* Développer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies de marketing d'influence pour soutenir les objectifs et buts de communication.
* Identifier, évaluer et intégrer des influenceurs dont les valeurs, la démographie de l'audience et le style de contenu correspondent à l'identité de marque et aux objectifs de communication de l'organisation.
* Négocier les contrats et accords avec les influenceurs, en assurant des attentes claires, des livrables et la conformité avec les directives et politiques organisationnelles.
* Coordonner les calendriers de création et de diffusion de contenu avec les influenceurs et les différentes filiales pour garantir l'alignement avec les échéances des campagnes et les objectifs de communication.
* Surveiller et analyser la performance des campagnes d'influence, en utilisant les données et les insights pour optimiser les stratégies et maximiser le retour sur investissement.
* Coordonner les initiatives des 30+ filiales avec les influenceurs et maintenir une vue d'ensemble globale.
**Gestion de Contenu Sportif & Sponsoring**
* Collaborer avec les partenaires sportifs (Équitation, Ski) pour sourcer, planifier et diffuser du contenu sur les plateformes sociales (Instagram, Broadcast, TikTok).
* Maintenir un calendrier éditorial qui fusionne le storytelling autour du sport, des créateurs et des moments saisonniers clés.
**Profil**
* Licence en communication, marketing, relations publiques ou domaine connexe.
* 3 à 5 ans d'expérience avérée en marketing d'influence, communication, partenariats de marque ou rôles similaires, de préférence en agence d'entreprise ou dans un environnement de marketing sportif.
* Solides compétences en gestion de projet, avec la capacité de gérer plusieurs campagnes simultanément, de prioriser efficacement et de livrer des résultats dans un environnement dynamique.
* Excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite, avec un grand souci du détail et la capacité de créer des messages convaincants pour des audiences diverses.
* Esprit analytique développé, capable d'interpréter les données de campagne, de mesurer la performance et de traduire les insights en recommandations actionnables.
* Bonne compréhension des plateformes sociales, des écosystèmes de créateurs, des outils de marketing d'influence et des plateformes d'analyse.
* Penseur créatif et innovant avec de fortes compétences en résolution de problèmes et une passion pour les industries de l'équitation et du ski.
* Bonne connaissance des athlètes clés, influenceurs, communautés, événements et tendances qui façonnent les univers sportifs de l'équitation et du ski.
* Capacité à identifier des opportunités culturellement pertinentes et à traduire les tendances sportives et lifestyle en activations marketing d'influence impactantes.
**Compétences requises**
* Joueur d'équipe collaboratif avec un état d'esprit et une attitude positifs.
* Passion pour la culture digitale, les médias sociaux, le storytelling porté par les créateurs, avec une curiosité constante pour les nouveautés du secteur.
* Penseur créatif apportant des idées fraîches, innovantes et de nouvelles perspectives aux campagnes.
* Désireux de remettre en question le statu quo et d'identifier de nouvelles opportunités de croissance et d'engagement pour la marque.
* Très organisé avec de solides compétences en priorisation et multitâche.
* Adaptable, flexible et capable de prospérer dans des environnements rapides.

As an Influencer Marketing Specialist, you'll be at the heart of our Digital Marketing team, shaping impactful creator partnerships and bringing innovative projects to life. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a keen eye for detail and the ability to craft compelling messages for diverse audiences.
* Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret campaign data, measure performance, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
* Solid understanding of social media platforms, creator ecosystems, influencer marketing tools, and analytics platforms.

* Adaptable, flexible, and able to thrive in fast-paced environments.
